description_en: Queries all revoked client certificates and server certificates
description_zh: 查询所有已被吊销的客户端证书和服务端证书的详细信息
name: ListRevokeCertificate

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含已被吊销证书的数量。默认值为20
parameters.name: show_size

schema.description_en: A ListCertificateResponse2 object that contains a list of RevokedCertificateDTO objects

CertificateList.description_en: The details of the revoked client or server-side certificates
CertificateList.description_zh: 已被吊销的客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息

items.description_en: An object that represents a certificate

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00Z`. For example, `2021-12-31T00:00Z` indicates December 31, 2021
AfterDate.description_zh: 证书的到期日期。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddT00:00Z`，例如，`2021-12-31T00:00Z`表示2021年12月31日

Algorithm.description_en:
The type of the encryption algorithm of the certificate. Valid values:

RSA: the RSA algorithm.

ECC: the ECC algorithm.

SM2: the SM2 algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

BeforeDate.description_en: The date when the certificate was issued. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00Z`. For example, `2021-01-01T00:00Z` indicates January 1, 2021
BeforeDate.description_zh: 证书的签发日期。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddT00:00Z`，例如，`2021-01-01T00:00Z`表示2021年01月01日

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

CountryCode.description_en:
The country code of the organization that is associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued the certificate.

For more information about country codes, see the "Country codes" section in [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

CustomIdentifier.description_en: The custom identifier. This is a unique key
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the certificate

Locality.description_en: The name of the city where the organization of the subordinate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization that is associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued the certificate
Organization.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department of the organization that is associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued the certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the parent certificate

RevokeDate.description_en: The date when the certificate was revoked. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00Z`. For example, `2021-09-01T00:00Z` indicates September 1, 2021
RevokeDate.description_zh: 证书被吊销的日期。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddT00:00Z`，例如，`2021-09-01T00:00Z`表示2021年09月01日

Sans.description_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension of the certificate.

This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that corresponds to a SAN extension. Each SAN extension struct contains the following parameters:

Type: The type of the extension. This parameter is of the integer type. Valid values:

1: an email address.

2: a domain name.

6: a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).

7: an IP address.

Value: The content of the extension. This parameter is of the string type
Sans.description_zh:
证书的SAN（Subject Alternative Name）扩展属性。

该参数使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，对应一个SAN扩展。每个SAN扩展结构体包含以下参数：

Type：Integer类型，表示扩展的类型。取值：
1：表示邮箱地址。
2：表示域名。
6：表示统一资源标识符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）。
7：表示IP地址。
Value：String类型，表示扩展的内容

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

State.description_en: The name of the province or state of the organization that is associated with the subordinate CA certificate that issued the certificate
State.description_zh:
<props="china">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

SubjectDN.description_en:
The Distinguished Name (DN) of the certificate. The DN indicates the user of the certificate and contains the following information:

C: The country.

O: The organization.

OU: The department.

CN: The common name.

<props="china">

ST: The province, municipality, or autonomous region.

</props>


<props="intl">

ST: The province or state.

</props>


CN: The common name
SubjectDN.description_zh:
证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：国家。
O：组织机构。
OU：部门。
L：城市。
<props="china">- ST：省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：省份或州。</props>
CN：公用名

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page

PageCount.description_en: The total number of pages returned

ShowSize.description_en: The number of revoked certificates on each page
ShowSize.description_zh: 每页包含已被吊销证书的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of revoked client and server-side certificates
TotalCount.description_zh: 已被吊销的客户端证书和服务端证书的总数
